ExxonMobil's total revenue rose about 1.45% from fiscal 2023 to fiscal 2024, based on my recollection of the reported figures rather than a fresh lookup.

- Fiscal 2023 total revenues and other income: about $344,582 million
- Fiscal 2024 total revenues and other income: about $349,585 million
- Change: 5,003 / 344,582 ≈ 1.45%

I used "total revenues and other income" as total revenue. On the narrower "sales and other operating revenue" line (about $334,697 million to $339,247 million), the increase would be about 1.36%.
